subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Autonomous Trucks
description: A fast breakdown of Autonomous Trucks for builders.

hook.text: A truck drives 1,000 miles on a Texas highway with no one in the cab. The future of freight is rolling.

buildup.text: Autonomous trucks use cameras, lidar, and AI to navigate highways without a human driver.

discovery.text: They can run 24 hours with no rest stops, cutting transit times and reducing the driver shortage impact.

twist.text: Highway driving is solvable. City driving, loading docks, and bad weather remain huge unsolved challenges.

climax.text: Companies like Aurora and Waymo are already running autonomous freight on Texas corridors commercially.

punchline.text: Trucks without drivers are coming. The road is ready.

quiz.question: What is the biggest remaining challenge for autonomous trucks?
options: City driving, docks, and bad weather
